sections.note: recurring global footer, see proposed footer rule

proposed_rules.trigger: A top-of-page text node whose content is raw JS source (e.g. starts with 'document.addEventListener("DOM...') rendered visibly, analogous to the confirmed leaked-css-text-node pattern but for inline scripts.
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude entirely from block inventory; treat as a source-leak artifact identical in spirit to leaked-css-text-node.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rendered JS source is never authorable content; appears identically at rc1 on every page in this batch, including this listing page.

proposed_rules.trigger: A bottom-of-page block with 'The best no-code platform for...' tagline text and a following '| |' separator line, identical across many pages.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as global site footer chrome; model as a site-wide fragment rather than page-specific default-content.
proposed_rules.rationale: Content and structure are byte-identical across unrelated pages, indicating shared footer markup rather than page content.

provenance.evidence: C233 rc3c1c1/rc3c1c2 'The best no-code platform for...' + '| |'

proposed_rules.trigger: A [region]-tagged FAQ answer node whose bounding box exactly overlaps a sibling question row's coordinates rather than sitting directly below its own question, because the capture froze an expanded/collapsed accordion state.
proposed_rules.decision: Reconstruct Q/A pairing by DOM/document order, not by on-screen position, when building the faq-accordion block rows.
proposed_rules.rationale: Positional overlap is a capture-time artifact of the accordion's absolute-positioned answer panel, not a real layout collision.

notes: Cookie overlay (rc5) excluded per knack-cookie-notice-overlay. This is the integrations category/listing hub page (distinct dominant layout from the per-partner pages in C227-C232) with an underrendered listing zone requiring Phase 2 follow-up.
